title: REQ · Pure PNG encoder writes timestamp-free deterministic bytes and reads its own header size
summary: encodePng(RgbaImage) returns identical bytes every call; readPngSize parses IHDR
description: Context: no PNG encoder exists and no PNG library is a dependency. Desired behavior: a pure function encodes an RgbaImage into a PNG (signature, IHDR, one IDAT via node:zlib at fixed level, IEND) with no tIME or text chunks, and a helper reads width and height from the IHDR. Why: determinism and header checks are the sub-goal's test targets.
acceptance_criteria: Given the same RgbaImage, when encodePng runs twice, then both byte arrays are equal
Given a 4x3 image, when readPngSize reads the encoded bytes, then it returns width 4 and height 3
Given the encoded bytes, when chunk types are listed, then only IHDR, IDAT and IEND appear
technical_constraints: No new npm dependency; use node:zlib
Phaser stays on 3.90.x and the existing stack stays
non_functional: Pure: no clock, no randomness, no fs
